strategic_findings.primary_source: NH HealthCost (nhhealthcost.nh.gov) — NH state government price transparency, per-provider per-procedure ESTIMATED CHARGE from the NH Comprehensive Healthcare Information System (claims, quarterly). strategic_findings.price_type: gov_estimated_charge (claims-derived; NOT the provider's own cash price) — distinct price_type; requires comparability guarding vs hospital MRF cash/negotiated.
strategic_findings.machine_readable: No CSV/JSON/API on provider pages (HTML); needs a reviewed collector + robots/terms check (do not bypass protections).
strategic_findings.mapping: No CPT codes on NH HealthCost — description-based deterministic mapping to canonical procedures, evidence-backed, false-positive detector after each batch.
strategic_findings.why_not_ingested_this_turn: New authoritative source + new price_type + comparability design is a reviewed batch; rushing risks the mandate's 'schema decision that risks corrupting production pricing' + unsafe comparisons. Flagged for owner-reviewed design as the primary next batch.
